plan.subject: Marketing science

queries.query: ("charm pricing" OR "left-digit effect" OR ".99 pricing" OR "psychological pricing") AND (marketing OR consumer OR retail OR pricing OR ecommerce)
queries.rationale: Catches evidence on whether price-ending tactics like .99 pricing shift demand, conversion, or willingness to pay.

queries.query: ("price promotion" OR "sales promotion" OR "temporary price reduction" OR coupon OR discounting) AND (marketing OR consumer OR retail OR ecommerce OR brand)
queries.rationale: Finds work on when discounts and promotions lift short-term sales versus erode margins, reference price, or brand perceptions.

queries.query: ("reference price" OR "internal reference price" OR "price fairness" OR "price image") AND (marketing OR consumer OR retail OR pricing OR ecommerce)
queries.rationale: Targets the mechanisms behind pricing responses, including fairness judgments and how past prices anchor future conversion.

queries.query: ("scarcity appeal" OR "scarcity message" OR "limited-time offer" OR "limited quantity" OR "stock scarcity") AND (marketing OR consumer OR ecommerce OR retail OR advertising)
queries.rationale: Surfaces studies on urgency and scarcity messaging, especially the conditions under which they increase checkout and purchase intent.

queries.query: ("social proof" OR "bandwagon effect" OR "popularity cue" OR "best seller" OR "most popular") AND (marketing OR consumer OR ecommerce OR retail OR advertising)
queries.rationale: Captures research on whether popularity cues and social proof increase conversion, trust, or choice share in shopping contexts.

queries.query: ("choice architecture" OR "default option" OR nudging OR "decision framing") AND (marketing OR consumer OR ecommerce OR retail OR "behavioral economics")
queries.rationale: Finds evidence on practical nudges, defaults, and framing interventions that influence shopper decisions without changing the core offer.

queries.query: ("message framing" OR "gain-loss framing" OR "attribute framing" OR "goal framing") AND (marketing OR consumer OR advertising OR persuasion OR ecommerce)
queries.rationale: Targets research on how framing the same offer or product benefit changes response rates and purchase decisions.

queries.query: ("advertising creativity" OR "creative advertising" OR "ad creativity" OR "advertising appeal") AND (marketing OR advertising OR consumer OR persuasion OR ecommerce)
queries.rationale: Catches work on which creative elements and appeals drive stronger ad performance rather than merely attracting attention.

queries.query: ("advertising effectiveness" OR "ad effectiveness" OR "persuasive message" OR "purchase intention") AND (marketing OR advertising OR consumer OR ecommerce OR retail)
queries.rationale: Provides a broader evidence stream on what kinds of ads convert, complementing narrower creative-specific queries.

queries.query: ("visual attention" OR "eye tracking" OR "visual salience" OR "gaze bias") AND (marketing OR advertising OR ecommerce OR consumer OR packaging)
queries.rationale: Finds studies connecting visual attention patterns to clicks, product choice, and conversion-relevant design decisions.

queries.query: ("landing page" OR "web design" OR "website aesthetics" OR "online store layout") AND (conversion OR ecommerce OR retail OR consumer OR usability)
queries.rationale: Targets research on page and storefront design features that affect trust, usability, and purchase conversion.

queries.query: ("conversion rate optimization" OR "online conversion" OR "purchase conversion" OR "checkout abandonment") AND (ecommerce OR retail OR marketing OR consumer OR website)
queries.rationale: Surfaces research directly tied to conversion outcomes, including frictions and interventions around checkout completion.

queries.query: ("product naming" OR "brand name" OR "brand naming" OR "name fluency") AND (marketing OR branding OR consumer OR advertising OR retail)
queries.rationale: Finds evidence on how names affect recall, perceived fit, processing fluency, and purchase likelihood.

queries.query: ("processing fluency" OR "linguistic fluency" OR "pronounceable brand name" OR "name fluency") AND (marketing OR branding OR consumer OR persuasion OR advertising)
queries.rationale: Catches the cognitive mechanism behind why certain names or wording styles feel easier, more trustworthy, or more persuasive.

queries.query: ("customer review" OR "online review" OR "review valence" OR "review helpfulness" OR "rating volume") AND (marketing OR consumer OR ecommerce OR retail OR platform)
queries.rationale: Captures evidence on how ratings, review volume, and review content shape purchase decisions in online commerce.

queries.query: ("personalization" OR "product recommendation" OR recommender OR "targeted offer") AND (marketing OR ecommerce OR retail OR consumer OR platform)
queries.rationale: Finds work on when personalized offers and recommendations improve conversion versus triggering privacy or relevance concerns.

plan.coverage_notes: This plan emphasizes evidence-heavy levers a growth marketer can actually test: pricing, promotions, nudges, ad creative, landing pages, product naming, reviews, and personalization. It mixes mechanism-oriented queries like reference price, framing, and fluency with applied queries closer to ecommerce conversion behavior. I skipped advertising history, media theory, and broad branding culture topics because the profile clearly prioritizes practical causal findings over interpretive or historical work.
